videos.title: How Lovable hit $10M ARR in just 2 months
videos.description:
Lovable just raised $400M in Series C funding. It started with 15 people and $10M ARR in two months. 

Anton Osika (co-founder of Lovable) on how it all began.

videos.title: Why companies need to change how they think about hiring
videos.description: Adam Ward (Head of Talent, Cursor) on why you need to treat every hire like an executive search - starting with rigorous scoping

videos.title: "If you build a great product and no one knows about it, did you even build a product?"
videos.description:
You can't be a product expert without also being a market expert.

Brian Chesky (CEO of Airbnb) on why product and marketing can't be separated.

videos.title: What the CEO of Airbnb wants every founder to know about micromanagement
videos.description:
Airbnb's CEO: "There's a difference between micromanagement, which is telling people exactly what to do, and being in the details."

Brian Chesky on why every founder should be in the details.

videos.title: Why the traditional recruiting model builds mediocre teams
videos.description: Adam Ward (Head of Talent, Cursor) explains how traditional recruiting methods leave you selecting candidates from a suboptimal pool.

videos.title: Why Airbnb doesn't have a CPO | Brian Chesky (CEO of Airbnb)
videos.description:
The CEO should be the chief product officer.

Brian Chesky (CEO of Airbnb) on why founders shouldn't delegate the one thing they're best at.

videos.title: Stop treating marketing like the waiters and engineering like the chefs
videos.description:
Your best marketers should sit next to your engineers, not behind them.

Brian Chesky (CEO of Airbnb) on the one heuristic he uses to judge how healthy a company really is.

videos.title: Recruiting top talent isn't one pitch
videos.description:
Recruiting top talent isn't one pitch. It's a continual touchpoint approach that can take days, weeks, months, or years.

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) on how he builds elite, high-talent-density teams.

videos.title: Scoping is the most under-invested step in hiring
videos.description:
If you can't objectively describe what "great" looks like for a role, you're not ready to hire for it.

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) explains why.

videos.title: This is the biggest unfair advantage in recruiting
videos.description: Adam Ward (Head of Talent, Cursor) explains the number one driver of candidate satisfaction.

videos.title: How to get better referrals
videos.description:
How to get better referrals: stop asking who's talented. Start asking who's talented at exactly what you need.

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) on sourcing top candidates the right way.

videos.title: "Remainder hiring is the output of the funnel of doom."
videos.description:
Only 20% of people reply to recruiting outreach. That 20% isn't necessarily the top 20%. 

Adam Ward (Head of Talent at Cursor) on the “funnel of doom,” and how to fix your hiring process.
